_comment: Copy this whole _template folder, rename the copy (any name, e.g. Kysthjelperne_2027 or Student_Hansen_Algae), then edit. Delete the section you do not need. Settings that start with an underscore are ignored.

sampling_log._comment: Survey export with one row per sample (the file that becomes safe_sampling_data.csv). Names that must be removed from comments go in private/names_to_remove.txt - NEVER in this file (it is committed to git).

edna._comment: metadata + water chemistry + species table of one eDNA campaign.
edna.title: Title shown in the website menu
edna.description: One or two sentences about the campaign.
